caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot centered on a plain, light beige background. The teapot is a deep brown color with lighter highlights indicating a glossy surface. It has a rounded, slightly fluted body, a curved spout on the left, and a large curved handle on the right. The teapot features a decorative relief design on its body, showing a person in a dress standing next to a well, with trees on either side of the figure. The lid is dome-shaped with a knob on top, and the teapot sits stably on a round base. The artist's signature, "AERUSH," appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
